description.en: Reading workspace for DeepSeek Harness: opens PDF, EPUB and Markdown in the main view with highlights, notes, concept cards next to the passage, a guide/mind map, and an in-reader conversation panel driven by the current Session.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的阅读工作台：在主视图阅读 PDF、EPUB 与 Markdown，支持高亮、笔记、留在原文处的概念卡、分层导读与导图，以及由当前会话驱动的阅读侧边对话。
